subject: design/feature-implementation-drive-argus-approval
statement: One versioned, medium-neutral `FeatureDrive` aggregate is the durable authority for a feature's integration lifecycle, and one deterministic reconciler is its only behavior. Short-lived local commands and remote wake workers load the same aggregate, verify external goal objects, plan typed idempotent effects, persist each intent by compare-and-swap, execute through ports, and reconcile the observed result; the feature-blind executor remains an effect target, never the lifecycle owner (`design-brainstorm:feature-implementation-drive-tech-design#D-1`).
